metadata.aggregation: Country-year totals by capture/aquaculture source, summed from species and FAO fishing-area rows.
metadata.interpretationLimit: Production volume is not seafood consumption, household food security, stock health, or proof of sustainable fishing. Underlying source flags can differ between component rows.
